name: matchbox-game-on
description: MATCHBOX GAME ON — collect 10 die-cast cars in 60 seconds. Three.js + Cannon.js + Socket.IO.
author: Jonny Shannon

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix client" "cd server && node src/index.js"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
